conventions.contract: CONTRACT_GEUMBANG §AQ (plan docs/geumbang_plan.md §6, §7, §10). Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: ui6 (late fragment, plan §12 G-P6).
conventions.mark: 금방이: gold disc, goldDark rim, cream sticker border, a face-on cream parcel with navy dot eyes, pink cheeks and an "o" mouth, a cream 4-point sparkle above. Same design as assets/geumbang (gb_lib.mark, variant A).
conventions.text: Text is baked ONLY into ui_gb_logo_ko ("금방") and ui_gb_logo_en ("Geumbang"); the game writes every other label (Pretendard). Body text >= 15 CSS px (28 logical), tap targets >= 44 CSS px, statuses always icon + word.
conventions.style: House soft-toy style (fxlib.toy): dark tinted outline, bevel lit from the upper left, gloss, one navy drop shadow; the mark is lit from straight above so it stays its own mirror image.
conventions.nineSlice: Panel frames live in the atlas UNTRIMMED: this.add.nineslice(x, y, 'ui6_gb', key, w, h, left, right, top, bottom) with nineSlice[key]. contentInset = [left, top, right, bottom] px from the stretched edges where content goes. Chip and ribbon: build them at their source height and scale uniformly (minHeight).

pagePlan.why: plan §10.4: the build packs the resident part with gb_bld_0 into gb_core; the app frames, tracker, logos and mascot ship as a transient page acquired only while the app is open.

conventions.appLayoutNotes: Suggested layout of the 720 x 1100 logical app panel (plan §6): the phone 9-slice fills the panel; header / tabs / content rects are in panel px; tracker y and x0..x1 are card px. The panel fills the viewport width, so every tap target is >= 88 logical (44 CSS on a 360 CSS phone, 47.7 on 390), body text 30 (15 / 16.3 CSS) and no text under 24 (12 / 13 CSS). Tabs / the follow button are the 64-tall 9-slices scaled uniformly by tabs.scale / button.scale; the catalog sell toggle is drawn 44 tall but its hit area is the 88-tall right half of the row (toggle.hitH). English tab words are the short set Today / Order / Shop / Crew / Stars. docs/previews/ui6_app.png and ui6_phaser_*.png show it.

ui_gb_logo_ko.notes: app header logo (ko): the mark + "금방" in navy with a cream rim (reads on the gold header, cream and dark). Header placement: x 44, y 42, scale 0.8 (appLayout.header.logo).

ui_gb_mark.notes: the mark 금방이 alone (app splash, the 금방 letter, newspaper ad, office row). Symmetric, no letters.

ui_gb_mascot.notes: 금방이 the mascot: the mark's parcel on stubby legs with a navy scarf (UI only, never mirrored - it runs to the right). idle = stands and waves (3 fps loop), run = runs in (8 fps loop; tween it in from the right edge of the header to appLayout.header.mascot when the app opens, then idle), bow = a polite bow (3 fps once; on the first delivery / a new review). Feet at the anchor.

ui_gb_phone.notes: the 금방 앱 panel (720 x 1100 logical, non-pausing) drawn as the chief's phone: charcoal bezel, speaker slot + camera, cream screen. screenRect [21, 30, 318, 580] at the source size; the screen corners are r 30, so the header (r 30) sits flush in it. Build it at 720 x 1100 (the top-centre speaker slot widens with the width - fine for 1.6-2.2x).

ui_gb_header.notes: the app header (gold): rounded top corners r 30 = the phone screen's, a goldDark lip, a soft shadow onto the screen below (the last 12 px). Logo left, tagline under it (navy, 26 px), close button right, the mascot runs in between (appLayout.header).

ui_gb_tab.notes: app tab (not selected): pale cream; write the word in warm grey #8A7A62 next to the tab icon.

ui_gb_tab_on.notes: app tab (selected): gold with gloss and a small shadow; word in navy. Same size and margins as ui_gb_tab so they swap in place. A new-content dot is code (a 14 px gold circle, white rim).

ui_gb_card.notes: order / product / stat card: warm white, hairline border, soft shadow, a gold strip down the left edge (inside the left margin). Done cards may setTint(0xF4F1EA).

ui_gb_chip.notes: HUD 금방 chip (plan §6: 120 x 44 CSS under the 업무 chip) and in-app buttons (따라가기): cream pill with a gold rim; ui_chip rules - build at 64 tall, setScale(h / 64) for smaller chips (minHeight 64).

ui_gb_toast.notes: toast (top centre under the clock row, <= 300 x 48 CSS): cream with a gold left edge; icon at contentInset left, one line of text.

ui_gb_ribbon.notes: blank gold ribbon with swallowtail ends for 특가 / 배달 중 / NEW labels (navy text, centred). Build it 48 tall and stretch only the width (minHeight 48).

ui_gb_photo.notes: doorstep photo print (fixed size, not a 9-slice): draw the 128 x 80 render texture at photoRect (x 24, y 16 from the frame's top-left) UNDER the frame - the window is transparent and its edge carries a soft inner shade; the gold tape and the mark sticker sit on top. Scale the whole thing for thumbnails.

fx_gb_bell.notes: 띵동 at the door (world space, with sfx_gb_doorbell on ring_doorbell's impact frame): the bell pops in, swings with ringing arcs and sparkles, settles. Draw it centred ~40 world px above the door bell (geumbangfolk bellPoint) at a constant screen size (about 40 CSS px: setScale(40 / (64 x zoom x 390 / 720))), depth over the courier; destroy on animationcomplete.
